title: The differential information content of earnings announcements: The case of merger*

rival_explanations: pair-matched non-merger control firms (secular / market-wide decline in return variability rather than the merger's reduction in future uncertainty)

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (merger firms spanning many two-digit SIC industries; banks and utilities excluded)
context.sample_description: Acquiring firms that experienced significant mergers (acquired firm's premerger sales at least 10 percent of the acquiring firm's), collected from Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A); banks and utilities excluded; firms required on the Industrial Compustat and CRSP tapes with annual earnings announcement dates in the Wall Street Journal Index; plus 102 matched-pair nonmerger control firms

analyses.label: Table 2 - Descriptive statistics (firm characteristics changes before and after merger)
analyses.sample: 102 merger firms and 102 matched control firms

dv.name: firm characteristics (size, asset turnover, leverage, dividend payout, ROE)

key_ivs.name: merger status and period (merger vs control firms; before vs after merger)
key_ivs.measure: 102 merger firms compared with 102 matched control firms; firm characteristics compared before vs after merger, tested with two-tailed t-test and Wilcoxon matched-pairs signed-rank test
key_ivs.source: Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A); Industrial Compustat tapes

analyses.label: Table 3 - Return variability of merger firms and control firms (total sample)
analyses.sample: 102 merger firms and 102 matched control firms

dv.name: return variability (RV) / information content of earnings announcement
dv.measure: squared value of standardized excess return used as a return variability (RV) measure; daily excess returns computed using the one-factor market model with Scholes and Williams (1977) beta, standardized following Patell (1976), over the 11 days (t = -5 to +5) surrounding the annual earnings announcement date

key_ivs.name: merger status and period (merger vs pair-matched control; year before vs year after merger)

analyses.label: Table 4 Panel A - Return variability of variance-decreasing firms
analyses.sample: 54 variance-decreasing merger firms and matched control firms

dv.name: return variability (RV) / information content of earnings announcement
dv.measure: squared standardized excess return (RV) over 11 days (t=-5 to +5) around annual earnings announcement, change from pre- to post-merger

key_ivs.name: change in firm variance after merger (variance-decreasing)
key_ivs.measure: premerger stock return variance computed over 150-day period ending 60 days before initial merger announcement; postmerger variance over 150-day period starting at merger completion date; firms classified variance-decreasing if variance declined after merger

analyses.label: Table 4 Panel B - Return variability of variance-increasing firms
analyses.sample: 48 variance-increasing merger firms and matched control firms

dv.name: return variability (RV) / information content of earnings announcement
dv.measure: squared standardized excess return (RV) over 11 days (t=-5 to +5) around annual earnings announcement, change from pre- to post-merger

key_ivs.name: change in firm variance after merger (variance-increasing)
key_ivs.measure: premerger stock return variance computed over 150-day period ending 60 days before initial merger announcement; postmerger variance over 150-day period starting at merger completion date; firms classified variance-increasing if variance rose after merger

analyses.label: Table 5 Panel A - Return variability of unrelated mergers

dv.name: return variability (RV) / information content of earnings announcement
dv.measure: squared standardized excess return (RV) over 11 days (t=-5 to +5) around annual earnings announcement, change from pre- to post-merger period

analyses.label: Table 5 Panel B - Return variability of related mergers

dv.name: return variability (RV) / information content of earnings announcement
dv.measure: squared standardized excess return (RV) over 11 days (t=-5 to +5) around annual earnings announcement, change from pre- to post-merger period
